page.overview:
Who is Balikina Furlisdotr?

High Priestess Balikina Furlisdotr is a matronly dwarf dedicated to the worship of Valaya. Despite her advanced age, her hair is still a striking black and she looks fit and strong. She is a member of the High Council of Karak Azgal and one of the most influential Dwarfs in the city. Balikina believes Dwarfs should make plans to retake the ruins beneath the city rather than simply trying to get rich off the hard work of others. She monitors the actions of the Brotherhood of the Forked Beard, but is not sure she should support them as of yet.
